newsitem.title: CANADA: Ontario raises wheat price forecast C$5 per tonne.
newsitem.headline: Ontario raises wheat price forecast C$5 per tonne.

text.p: Ontario wheat prices on Tuesday were forecast to rise C$5 a tonne due to recent gains in Chicago Board of Trade futures values, the Ontario Wheat Producers' Marketing Board said.
Ontario's total wheat crop output was projected to reach 565,000 tonnes with winter wheat yields 15 to 20 percent higher than previously anticipated, the OWPMB said.

"The possibility of a drought in western Canada and the northern United States may reduce world supply calculations and cause an earlier-than-expected market upswing," the OWPMB said in its August estimates report.
